works.title: Our work
works.subtitle: Personalized compositions created from our customers’ photos and stories.
works.personalDescription: A unique composition created from your photo.
works.personalModalDescription: Compositions for one person, a hobby, a profession, or a special look. You can add a name, date, pet, accessories, and lighting.
works.coupleDescription: Your shared story brought to life in the smallest details.
works.coupleModalDescription: A gift for an anniversary, wedding, proposal, or an important moment together. You can add names, a date, a pet, and details from your story.
works.familyDescription: A warm gift for family, children, and those closest to you.
works.familyModalDescription: A warm composition for families, children, parents, and pets. A great choice for family celebrations and memorable gifts.
works.weddingDescription: A keepsake frame with your couple, date, and names.
works.weddingModalDescription: We create elegant frames with wedding figures — featuring your couple, date, names, and meaningful details from your story. If you would like wedding figures specifically, message us on Telegram and we will tell you which options are available.
works.openPhotoHint: Select a photo to enlarge it
works.instagramTitle: See more of our work on Instagram
works.instagramDescription: New compositions, behind-the-scenes details, and gift ideas.

advantages.title: Our advantages
advantages.subtitle: A simple and clear process — from your idea to the finished gift.
advantages.photoDescription: We match each character’s appearance, clothing, and details to your story.
advantages.approvalDescription: We confirm your preferences, price, timeline, and all important details in advance.
advantages.productionDescription: The timeline depends on the complexity of the composition and the chosen design.
advantages.deliveryDescription: We deliver within Latvia and ship orders to other European countries.

personalization.title: What you can
personalization.subtitle: Every composition can be tailored to your story — from the characters’ appearance to the background, inscription, and lighting.
personalization.charactersDescription: One person, a couple, a family, or a group of friends.
personalization.facesHairDescription: We will match the appearance to your photos.
personalization.clothesDescription: Choose the style, colors, and look of each character.
personalization.accessoriesDescription: Add hobbies, professions, and meaningful details from your story.
personalization.petsDescription: Place a beloved pet beside the characters.
personalization.backgroundDescription: Choose a design that matches the occasion and mood.
personalization.inscriptionDescription: Add names, a date, or a personal message.
personalization.lightingDescription: Choose warm light, RGB, or a cloud effect.

lighting.title: Lighting options
lighting.subtitle: Choose the atmosphere for your composition
lighting.garlandDescription: Warm, cozy light from a string of LEDs
lighting.garlandModalDescription: Warm, cozy lighting with one light mode. Ideal for a soft, homelike atmosphere.
lighting.rgbDescription: Lighting with different colors and modes
lighting.rgbModalDescription: Bright colored lighting. A good choice if you want a more striking effect and a range of shades.
lighting.cloudsDescription: A three-dimensional cloud effect with soft, diffused light
lighting.cloudsModalDescription: A three-dimensional decorative effect with soft, diffused lighting. It looks more unusual and vibrant.

otherProducts.title: Other FORMIKA products
otherProducts.readyDescription: Ready-made models that can be ordered immediately.
otherProducts.readyModalDescription: Ready-made FORMIKA models available to order immediately. A great small gift or an addition to a frame.
otherProducts.customDescription: A keychain with a character you can customize to look like you.
otherProducts.customModalDescription: A keychain with a character you can customize — choose the face, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories.

orderProcess.title: How we create your gift
orderProcess.subtitle: From idea to finished composition — simple and clear.
orderProcess.chooseDescription: Select the composition, characters, and additional details.
orderProcess.submitDescription: Your completed request is sent to us via Telegram.
orderProcess.approveDescription: We clarify your preferences, the price, the timeline, and the delivery method.
orderProcess.createDescription: After approval and prepayment, we carefully assemble your gift.
orderProcess.handoverDescription: Pickup or delivery within Latvia and to other European countries.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.subtitle: Kind words about personalized gifts created by FORMIKA.
reviews.anyaText: I ordered an anniversary gift. It turned out very personal and beautiful, and every detail was matched perfectly to us.
reviews.mariaText: Very neat work. The warm lighting looks incredibly cozy in the evening.
reviews.sofiaText: I loved that we could include every family member, our pet, and a date that is important to us.
reviews.kristinaText: The lighting has different colors and modes. The gift turned out bright and unusual.
reviews.elenaText: We discussed the details quickly, and the composition was made exactly from our photo.
reviews.lizaText: The keychain turned out very cute and really resembled the person I ordered it for.
reviews.dianaText: The cloud effect and colored lighting create a wonderful atmosphere. It looks even better in person.
reviews.olgaText: The order arrived carefully packaged. Everything looked beautiful and was ready on time.
reviews.victoriaText: I loved the detail in the figures and how carefully our preferences were taken into account.

delivery.title: Delivery and Payment
delivery.intro: All order details are agreed personally via Telegram. Before production, we confirm the contents, price, and timeline.
delivery.applicationText: You build your composition on the website and submit the order.
delivery.approvalText: We clarify the details, item availability, and final price.
delivery.productionText: Once everything is confirmed, we begin creating your order.
delivery.latviaText: The delivery method and delivery details are confirmed when the order is agreed in Telegram.
delivery.beforeWorkText: The first payment is made after the order details and price have been confirmed.
delivery.afterReadyText: The remaining amount is paid after the order has been completed.
delivery.productionTimeText: The exact timeline depends on the complexity of the composition, the number of figures, and the availability of the selected details.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We treat our customers’ personal information with care and use it only to prepare, create, and deliver an order.
privacy.dataText: FORMIKA may receive your name, Telegram username, phone number, delivery address, and order comments.
privacy.orderDataText: This information is used to contact you, clarify details, create the product, and arrange delivery.
privacy.photosText: These are used only to create a personalized product for your order.
privacy.sharingText: FORMIKA does not sell personal data or share it with third parties for advertising. Information may be used only to fulfill the order, communicate with the customer, and arrange delivery.
privacy.finishedPhotosText: Photos of finished products are published on the website or social media only with the customer’s consent. If you do not want your order to be published, let us know when the order is being confirmed.
privacy.changeDeleteText: You may request that your data be changed or deleted. Message us on Telegram or Instagram, and we will review your request.

terms.title: Order Terms
terms.intro: FORMIKA creates personalized products to individual specifications. No registration is required — all details are confirmed personally via Telegram.
terms.choiceText: You choose the format, figures, details, and design of the composition.
terms.applicationText: The completed request is sent to us via Telegram.
terms.approvalText: We check the details, item availability, price, and timeline.
terms.confirmationTitle: When an order is considered confirmed
terms.afterApprovalText: A submitted request is not yet a final confirmed order. First, we check whether it can be produced, whether the selected details are available, the timeline, and the final price.
terms.beforeConfirmationText: We clarify the contents, price, and production time.
terms.afterConfirmationText: The order goes into production after it has been agreed with the customer.
terms.personalCompositionText: Each product is created according to your selected parameters: format, number of figures, inscriptions, details, and design.
terms.differencesText: Colors, figures, accessories, and lighting may differ slightly from the examples on the website due to item availability. Any substitutions are agreed with the customer.
terms.personalMaterialsText: Submitted photos, names, and other materials are used only to prepare the personalized order.
terms.publicationText: Photos of the finished product may be published on the website or social media only with the customer’s consent.
terms.ctaSubtitle: All details are confirmed in advance
terms.ctaText: Before work begins, we agree on the composition, possible substitutions, price, and production time.
